identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.6: the saved appearance comes back after a revive (no more missing head), /coat works over MP shirts, and male pieces with no model were removed (Left Ring 5, Wrist Binding 6, MP Accessories 6, 14, 39, 42, 50, 61).

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.109: the key that locks your car is now set in the config (Config.LockKey, the same key on foot and in the car; update your RCO cars too so their prompt follows it); /carreturn tows your vehicles back to their garages and /givekey <id> [hours] lends your car's key (both can be turned off); on VORP the repair kit and the cloth are always taken from the inventory, also on edited inventories.

gym.message: RCO Gym 0.0.86: a set counts only from 5 good reps (Config.Progression.MinReps): one left sooner gives no experience, record or tiredness. 0.0.85: the record board and the load picker take the UI focus: the character and the camera stay still while they are open. 0.0.83: the exercises' animations play again. 0.0.82: the gym on the map (Config.Blip). 0.0.81: first release. A working 1890 gymnasium in Strawberry: 21 exercises on our own equipment, each with its own minigame; strength per muscle group with the muscle on the body (RCO Appearance, RSG Appearance or VORP Character); fatigue, warm-up and strains; wind for stamina and a harder punch; records, the week's champion and a spotter who can save your rep.
